Hello! I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer — its files, disks, network and accounts are mine to work with, and I'm here to work for you.

- **Web app** — this is it, https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice here.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger, Instagram** — I can have my own accounts on each, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan my QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **Own accounts elsewhere** — I can create my own accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask for your help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing I'm missing: I don't know yet what name and gender to use for myself — tell me how you'd like to call me and how I should speak about myself, and I'll set it. What would you like to start with?

Hello — I'm **Diego**, a *bia*: an assistant that lives on this computer. The machine, its disks, its accounts and its network are mine to work with, for you.

- **Web app** — you're in it now: https://127.0.0.1:8443 · CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca — from any phone or computer on the same network the first visit installs the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice. Access stays closed until you ask: it needs a client certificate I issue when you say so.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code I show you. Want any of those?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can register and sign in to services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **And more** — scheduled jobs, running commands, learning languages, talking by voice.

One thing I don't have from you yet: my name. I'm using *Diego* for now — keep it, or would you rather call me something else? (And it/they, in languages that force a gender.)

What would you like to start with?
